title: China's CXMT shares fall 8% as investors look past profit turnaround; context of chip rout
summary: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) fell 7.8% on Oct. 19 despite forecasting 131–132.5 billion yuan net profit for Jan–Sept 2026. Earlier this month CXMT's denser-server-memory announcement triggered a global chip stock rout that wiped over 00B from Nvidia and peers; now CXMT itself is selling off.
why: CXMT是10月芯片赛道动荡的核心触发因素；SK海力士、美光、英伟达等组合持仓均受冲击，且CXMT在盈利好转情况下股价仍跌，反映市场对中国存储芯片技术突破的长期担忧；隐含波动率短期偏高，sell put需谨慎选行权价。

title: US tech stocks rebound Monday as chip ETF snaps 9-day slide; Nasdaq +1.1% ahead of Mag 7 earnings
summary: On Oct. 19 the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.1% to 26,431 and S&P 500 gained 0.4% to 7,691 as tech and chip stocks bounced back from oversold levels. The Philadelphia Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) snapped a nine-consecutive-session losing streak. Of the 47 S&P 500 companies that have reported Q3, 85% beat estimates.
why: 科技板块经历9个交易日下跌后显著反弹，说明短期恐慌情绪有所缓和；对组合持有的英伟达、SK海力士等期权的卖出时机具有参考意义——高波动率环境正在收敛，是sell put策略潜在入场窗口。

title: Mag 7 earnings week: Tesla reports Oct. 21, Alphabet Oct. 28; SpaceX merger proxy adds intrigue
summary: Tesla (TSLA) reports Q3 2026 after the close on Oct. 21, with EPS consensus ~/bin/bash.43 vs. /bin/bash.50 a year ago on ~7.9B revenue. Tesla's annual meeting proxy (filed Oct. 19) reveals a SpaceX board crossover, fueling a ~3.8% Monday rally on merger speculation. Alphabet reports Oct. 28, same day as SK Hynix results and FOMC.
why: 特斯拉Q3财报是本周最大催化剂；SpaceX并购传言带来重大不确定性（Barclays称可能年内公告）；期权隐含波动率极高，财报后波动率骤降是sell put方向的重要风险点。

title: Oil falls to 07.8 on Russia sanctions relief, but Iran Hormuz attacks keep supply risk elevated
summary: Brent crude fell ~1.9% to 07.8 on Oct. 18 after Washington suspended Russia sanctions, but Iran continued escalating tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. Hormuz crude flows were at 70% of pre-Iran-conflict levels. A Friday Brent spike to 10 — highest since May — reflected acute supply-chain risk.
why: 油价高位震荡（07-10）是输入性通胀的核心驱动力，直接影响9月CPI 3.7%以及美联储是否在10月28日进一步加息的判断；持仓中与消费相关的标的（麦当劳、海底捞、携程）受油价成本传导压力。

title: SK hynix poised for record Q3 on HBM4 demand; 6th straight record expected, results Oct. 28
summary: Analyst consensus (FnGuide) expects SK hynix Q3 2026 operating profit at ~76.96 trillion won, a 6th consecutive quarterly record. HBM4 revenue is fully counted from Q3, and J.P. Morgan estimates SK hynix holds ~54% of Nvidia's HBM supply in 2026. Results due Oct. 28 (Seoul time).
why: SK海力士Q3季报（10月28日）与FOMC议息会议同日，双重催化剂叠加；HBM4全面放量验证AI内存超级周期，是CSOP两倍做多SK海力士ETF及相关期权持仓的核心逻辑验证；季报前sell put需考虑双边波动风险。

title: Paralysed Keeta rider caught in insurance limbo after HK crash — gig-work law gap exposed
summary: A 54-year-old Keeta delivery rider was paralysed in a May 2026 crash; Meituan's platform has not resolved his insurance claim months later. SCMP and HKFP report that Hong Kong's planned gig-work law could exclude riders injured 'between orders' from statutory compensation.
why: Keeta是美团出海核心资产，此案若推动香港立法强化骑手保障要求，将增加平台运营成本，存在监管风险溢价；是美团港股沽期权需关注的负面催化剂。

title: Circle defends USDC's 7-cent profit model as Open USD rivals court partners with bigger revenue share
summary: Circle disclosed it kept ~7 cents of net profit per dollar of H1 2026 revenue. Visa-backed Open USD and newcomers offer larger partner revenue splits targeting Coinbase — Circle's largest USDC distributor. GENIUS Act full enforcement starts January 18, 2027; USDC circulation was 3.3B in Q2.
why: 稳定币竞争加剧（Visa OpenUSD直接挑战USDC合作生态），Circle(CRCL)边际盈利受压；GENIUS Act监管1月落地将增加合规成本；持仓期权需关注竞争格局变化对CRCL估值的影响。延续报道：竞争态势仍在发酵。

title: 泡泡玛特Labubu「一喵成猫」系列首发：隐藏款得物峰值近7倍溢价，普通款逾半数跌破发行价
summary: 泡泡玛特10月15日推出Labubu全新「一喵成猫」系列（发行价129元），神秘款「缅因喵喵」在得物平台峰值二手价899元（约发行价6.97倍）；但普通款已有超半数低于发行价，且「四耳」设计遭受社交媒体批评，整体首发热度明显分化。
why: 延续报道：Labubu新系列首发反应是泡泡玛特IP可持续性的核心验证点；神秘款高溢价显示核心收藏需求仍旺，但普通款破发+设计争议可能削弱大众吸引力，影响H2销售指引，需关注sell put行权风险。

title: Temu settles Texas data privacy lawsuit for $3M; agrees to store US user data domestically
summary: PDD Holdings' Temu agreed to a $3M settlement with Texas over data privacy and product safety claims. The deal requires Temu to store Texans' personal data on U.S.-based servers and annual independent product safety testing. Texas is the first state to resolve such claims; several others have similar suits pending.
why: Temu是拼多多最大增长引擎；美国各州监管收紧（数据本地化+产品安全测试）将推高合规成本，后续类似诉讼风险仍高；对PDD期权看空方向有支撑，需关注是否形成全国性监管先例。

title: Moomoo extends U.S. options trading to pre-market and post-close sessions via Cboe
summary: Futu's Moomoo launched extended options trading hours on Oct. 19: 25 U.S.-listed stocks and 5 ETFs now tradeable 7:30–9:25 a.m. ET (pre-market) and 4:00–4:15 p.m. ET (post-close) via Cboe Exchange, making Moomoo the first retail platform to offer these extended-hours options.
why: 富途拓展期权交易时段是moomoo差异化服务里程碑，提升用户活跃度与佣金收入；对FUTU估值有正面贡献，且对使用moomoo执行sell put/covered call策略的用户有直接实用意义（可捕捉盘前财报后波动率）。
